title: Chamberlain opener safety sensor obstructed
shortDescription: 1 LED flash on opener indicates safety beam blocked.
fullDescription:
Chamberlain garage door openers count LED flashes near the Learn button to signal errors. 1 flash means the safety reversing sensors at the bottom of the door rails are misaligned or obstructed.

Clean lenses and align until both sensor LEDs are solid (no blinking).

fixSteps.title: Clean lenses
fixSteps.instruction: Wipe both sensor lenses with dry cloth.

fixSteps.title: Align
fixSteps.instruction: Loosen wing nuts, align sensors so receiver LED is solid green.

fixSteps.title: Inspect wire
fixSteps.instruction: Check entire sensor wire run for staples through insulation.

whenToCallPro: If wire is damaged inside wall.

faq.q: What does sensor LED color mean?
faq.a: Green = sending; amber = receiving; blinking = misaligned.

title: Sensor wire shorted
shortDescription: 2 LED flashes indicate a short in safety sensor wiring.
fullDescription:
Two LED flashes near the Learn button mean the safety sensor circuit is shorted. A staple through the wire or a pinched cable typically causes it.

Disconnect the sensors and reconnect; if the LED stops, the issue is in the sensor or wire.

fixSteps.title: Disconnect sensors
fixSteps.instruction: Unplug both white/white-black wires at opener. Power-cycle. If LED resolves, wire shorted.

fixSteps.title: Replace wire
fixSteps.instruction: Run new 22-gauge bell wire from opener to sensors. Avoid stapling tightly.

whenToCallPro: If wire is buried in walls.

faq.a: Yes with weatherproof connectors; new wire is more reliable.

title: Door control button or wire short
shortDescription: 3 flashes mean door control button stuck or shorted.
fullDescription: Three flashes indicate the multi-function door control wiring (white/red) is shorted. Could be a stuck button, damaged wire, or moisture in the wall control.

fixSteps.title: Disconnect wall control
fixSteps.instruction: Remove white/red leads at opener; if LED clears, wall control is at fault.

fixSteps.title: Replace wall control
fixSteps.instruction: Install new Chamberlain multi-function door control.

whenToCallPro: If running new wire through walls.

faq.a: Yes after years of use or moisture exposure.

title: Sensor alignment marginal
shortDescription: 4 flashes mean safety sensors slightly misaligned.
fullDescription: Four flashes indicate the safety sensors are partially aligned. The receiver detects intermittent signal. Realign by loosening wing nuts.

fixSteps.title: Tighten brackets
fixSteps.instruction: Snug wing nuts and ensure sensors are facing each other.

fixSteps.title: Clear obstructions
fixSteps.instruction: Move tools, hoses, etc. away from sensor path.

faq.a: Yes, but signal is partially received vs fully blocked.

title: Logic board fault
shortDescription: 5 flashes indicate a logic board (RPM/motor sensor) fault.
fullDescription: Five flashes signal an RPM sensor or logic board issue. The motor stop mechanism cannot read motor position. Often after lightning strike or surge.

fixSteps.title: Replace logic board
fixSteps.instruction: Order Chamberlain replacement logic board for your model and swap.

title: Motor overload
shortDescription: 6 flashes mean motor overload or excessive force.
fullDescription:
Six flashes indicate motor overload, often caused by spring tension issues, lubrication problems, or door binding. The motor draws too much current.

Manually open the door to test for binding.
symptoms: Door very heavy to lift manually

fixSteps.title: Manual test
fixSteps.instruction: Pull release cord. Door should lift smoothly with one hand to halfway and stay.

fixSteps.title: Lubricate
fixSteps.instruction: Spray garage door lubricant on rollers, hinges, springs.

fixSteps.title: Spring service
fixSteps.instruction: Call professional for torsion spring replacement; do not DIY (severe injury risk).

whenToCallPro: Spring work; severe injury risk if done DIY.

faq.a: Strongly discouraged; tension can cause severe injury.

title: Chamberlain WiFi opener will not pair
shortDescription: Built-in WiFi opener fails to join myQ network.
fullDescription:
Chamberlain B970 / B550 with built-in WiFi enter setup by holding the Learn button until LED flashes blue. Connect phone to the temporary myQ-xxxx access point and use the myQ app.

2.4GHz only, WPA2 only.

fixSteps.title: Enter setup
fixSteps.instruction: Hold Learn button 6 seconds; LED flashes blue.

fixSteps.title: Connect phone
fixSteps.instruction: Connect phone WiFi to myQ-xxxx temporary AP.

fixSteps.title: App setup
fixSteps.instruction: myQ app guides through entering home WiFi credentials.

faq.a: Built-in WiFi models do not. Older models need a myQ Hub.

title: Chamberlain remote does not open door
fullDescription: Chamberlain remotes use rolling code; if not paired or batteries dead, they fail. Newer Security+ 2.0 (yellow Learn button) and older Security+ (red/orange/purple) remotes are not cross-compatible.
symptoms: Door responds to wall but not remote

fixSteps.title: Re-pair
fixSteps.instruction: Press Learn on opener; press remote button within 30 seconds.

fixSteps.title: Verify model
fixSteps.instruction: Check remote and opener Learn button color match.

faq.q: How many remotes can I pair?

title: Outdoor wireless keypad does not open door
shortDescription: Keypad PIN entry has no effect.
fullDescription:
Chamberlain wireless keypads use a 9V battery and pair to the opener like a remote. Cold weather, dead battery, or a forgotten PIN are common failures.

Replace battery with fresh 9V; reprogram PIN if forgotten.
symptoms: Beep but door does not move

fixSteps.title: Reprogram
fixSteps.instruction: Press Learn on opener; enter 4-digit PIN on keypad and press Enter.

title: Opener motor buzzes but door does not move
shortDescription: Motor hums but door stays in place.
fullDescription:
If the motor buzzes without movement, either the door is locked (lock button engaged), trolley is disconnected from chain/belt, or capacitor is dead.

Check lock button and that trolley is engaged on the rail.

fixSteps.title: Re-engage trolley
fixSteps.instruction: Pull manual release cord upward to re-engage trolley.

fixSteps.title: Disable lock
fixSteps.instruction: Press Lock button on wall control to release.

fixSteps.title: Capacitor service
fixSteps.instruction: If still buzzing, professional capacitor replacement.

whenToCallPro: Capacitor work involves stored charges; pro recommended.

faq.a: Lock button on wall control disables remotes intentionally.

title: Chamberlain opener won't close door
shortDescription: Press close, door starts then reverses.
fullDescription: Reverse on close means safety photo eyes triggered or close-force too low. Verify eyes clean and force adjusted.

fixSteps.title: Adjust close force
fixSteps.instruction: Force adjustment screws on motor head.

title: Chamberlain door reverses or stalls
fullDescription: Open/close force settings calibrate motor torque. Cold weather, worn springs, or rust raise required force.

fixSteps.title: Adjust force screws
fixSteps.instruction: Quarter-turn at a time motor head.

fixSteps.title: Inspect springs
fixSteps.instruction: Visible gap or stretched coils means replace.

whenToCallPro: Replace torsion springs only with pro.

title: Chamberlain RPM sensor fail flash
fullDescription: 5-flash code = RPM sensor failure. Sensor on motor monitors rotation; failure stops opener.

title: Chamberlain limit switch error
shortDescription: Door doesn't stop at correct open/close position.
fullDescription: Travel limits set incorrect; opener may slam closed or stop short.

fixSteps.title: Reset travel
fixSteps.instruction: Hold ADJUST until LED on; press up arrow until correct open; release; press down to set close.

title: Chamberlain myQ hub not pairing
shortDescription: Built-in myQ hub fails Wi-Fi setup.
fullDescription: Built-in myQ in B970/B4545 needs 2.4GHz, fresh app, and learn button press timing.

fixSteps.title: Press learn 1x
fixSteps.instruction: Yellow learn button on motor; LED on.

title: Chamberlain battery backup fail
fullDescription: Battery backup (475LM) lasts 5 years typical. Red LED means replace.

title: Chamberlain wall control not working
fullDescription: Wall control wired to motor head; loose terminal screws or short cause failure.

fixSteps.title: Reseat wires
fixSteps.instruction: Verify 2 wires to motor head terminals.

title: Chamberlain remote not working
fullDescription: Remote battery dies (CR2032 or 3V coin) or remote unpaired by 3-press learn-erase.

fixSteps.title: Re-pair
fixSteps.instruction: Press learn on opener, then remote button within 30s.

title: Chamberlain opener motor runs but door doesn't move
fullDescription: Plastic drive gear strips after 8-12 years. Repair kit (41A2817 / 41A2817-1) replaces gear and sprocket.

fixSteps.title: Replace gear kit
fixSteps.instruction: Disassemble motor head, swap gear & sprocket.

whenToCallPro: Hire pro if uncomfortable disassembling motor head.

title: Chamberlain door doesn't stop at limits
fullDescription: Travel limits drift after spring service or after track adjustment. Re-run learn travel.

fixSteps.title: Relearn travel
fixSteps.instruction: Hold ADJUST/Set, set up then down positions.
